author: Nintendo of America
description:
Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea launches on November 18, 2026 for Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6001aLG9H
 
Become a magical mermaid and plunge into the waters of the Keepsake Sea! Uncover what secrets lie beneath the waves and set sail on a thrilling new ocean adventure. 
   
Befriend five new Villagers and an Adventure Companion, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, Megara, Captain Hook, Wendy, and Dory!

Play Minecraft, now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://ninten.do/6007aINd3
